verses.text: A thoughtful psalm of David, written when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry out loud to the LORD. I beg the LORD for mercy.
I pour out my complaint to him. I tell him all my troubles.
When my spirit grows weak inside me, you know the way I should go. On the path where I walk, people have hidden a trap for me.
Look to my right and see. No one cares about me. There is no place for me to hide. No one cares what happens to me.
I cry to you, LORD. I say, "You are my safe place. You are all I have in the land of the living."
Listen to my cry, because I am in desperate need. Rescue me from those who chase me, because they are too strong for me.
Set me free from my prison, so that I can praise your name. Then good people will gather around me, because you have been good to me.
